title: Starting state
summary: Before anything has run a machine case (no QA run, no plan result, not in a live roster), yoke qa requirement update --field starting_state re-declares it from one JSON object: as_is with a starting_state_reason, or baseline with a host_baseline. It rewrites in-flight admitted copies too. Afterwards it refuses starting_state_case_executed toward a corrected case and supersede; an item row materialized from a plan refuses starting_state_plan_owned toward the plan edit; inherit is declared only on a plan case. A mission whose sign-in or GUI-opened session must survive declares as_is; the walker opens sessions through the native GUI/desktop route itself and requests only a password entry while it holds the host lease.
